budget_views.amortised: measured break-even decision count including one-time training cost
budget_views.deciding: equal measured compute cost priced on recorded hardware

analysis_policy.comparator_policy: Exact finite-set regret is allowed only after all potentially competitive designs are sufficiently resolved; otherwise report only a difference from the best observed feasible design.
analysis_policy.group_reporting: REPRESENTATIVE and BOUNDARY_STRESS are reported separately; no combined weighting is approved.
analysis_policy.missing_evidence_policy: A confirmed violation remains CONFIRMED_INFEASIBLE even if another required condition is unavailable; no violation plus missing evidence is UNRESOLVED.
analysis_policy.reliability_policy: Descriptive fixed-pilot counts only; no population reliability or generalisation interval.

comparator.definition: best reference-feasible design in the registered finite eight-design by six-condition set when sufficiently resolved
comparator.limitations: Best-known only within the registered eight geometries, six current commands and 2D magnetostatic scope; it is not a global optimum.

conclusion.does_not_establish: No customer acceptance, global optimality, population reliability, 3D/thermal/dynamic performance, scientific qualification or LIVE readiness.
conclusion.establishes: Only the observed DEVELOPMENT outcomes for the frozen finite set, models, methods, budgets and admitted evidence class.
conclusion.observed_outcome: The registered model/search arms selected different geometries.

statistical_interpretation.future_uncertainty_requirement: An approved sampling design and a justified independent-observation unit.
statistical_interpretation.reason: The four arms share one decision problem and may reuse the same design-condition evidence; uses are not independent samples.

operating_control: A fixed geometry is evaluated at six commanded peak-current-density and current-angle pairs. The command is assumed settled before each magnetostatic sweep; controller dynamics, voltage limits, speed, thermal limits and inverter feasibility are outside this study.
